name: doc
title: Document with marks
shows: A page of a document (here a returns policy) with marked phrases and a note beside the current one: what kind of issue, what is wrong, where else it appears. Runs off the panel's bottom edge.
place: at-corner to-edge with .stage--fade-b, 32 to 40px in: the page runs past the bottom edge (a cut page, never a whole sheet floating in the panel); the first mark sits in its top half so the note never lands in the fade
edit: Write the client's own document. Mark phrases with <mark class="ui-doc__mark">. The first mark's note is the note box as written; give a later mark its own note on the mark itself (data-kind, data-msg, data-where), or pass opts.notes [{kind, msg, where}] in mark order. A mark with no note stays a quiet underline: the script never shows a note the page did not write.
loop: about 2.7 s a cycle: two marks in turn, each sweeping in with its note sliding up beside it; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
